---
title: "Slides (revealjs)"
---

A revealjs presentation with panzoom on every image, shown in a frame. Click the
slides, then move between them with the arrow keys. In the frame, the viewer
covers the slides only; in full screen, or with the [slides on their
own](revealjs-slides.html), it covers the whole screen.

```{=html}
<iframe id="slides" class="slides-frame" src="revealjs-slides.html"
  title="panzoom in revealjs slides" allow="fullscreen" allowfullscreen
  width="100%" style="aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; border: 1px solid #ccc;"></iframe>
<p>
  <button id="slides-full-screen" type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm"
    onclick="document.getElementById('slides').requestFullscreen()">
    Full screen
  </button>
</p>
```

The slides are a page of their own, with the resources embedded, so the frame
loads one file. The YAML header:

```yaml
---
format:
  revealjs:
    embed-resources: true
filters:
  - panzoom
panzoom: true
---
```
